test_cases.test_case: Very long text entered into Search Activity field

Or: input is visibly truncated in the UI or an inline validation error is shown indicating the input exceeds the allowed length (is blocked / error shown). The UI must show which of the two outcomes occurred (full text shown vs truncation/error).

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly switch Office_Selector values including an office with no data
preconditions: User is authenticated and on Home_Page
At least two offices exist in Office_Selector, one of which has no metrics/data
steps: 1. Click the Dashboard button on the Home_Page
2. Click Office_Selector to open the office list
3. Select Office A from the Office_Selector
4. Immediately (within one second) select Office B from the Office_Selector, where Office B has no data
5. Wait for the dashboard to finish updating (observe visual update indicators if present)
test_cases.expected_result: Final state corresponds to the last selected office (Office B). Client_Trends_Chart, Amount_Pending_Disbursed_Card, and Amount_Collected_Card update to reflect Office B (succeeds). If Office B has no data, both Amount_* cards explicitly display the text 'No Data' and the Client_Trends_Chart shows no data for the selected office (succeeds). There must be no persisted display of Office A's data after the update completes.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt duplicate create via browser Back after successful holiday creation

preconditions: Open the Audit Trails page so the Filters panel with From_Date and To_Date is visible
steps: 1. Enter <From date> into the From_Date filter
2. Enter <To date earlier than From date> into the To_Date filter
3. Click Apply_Filters
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the To_Date field indicating 'To Date must be on or after From Date' (or equivalent); the filters are not applied and the audit results remain unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Approve/Reject actions are not available when maker-checker is disabled
preconditions: In Global Configuration the 'maker-checker' configuration is set to Disabled (Enabled = false)
An audit trail row exists with Processing_Result == Pending
steps: 1. Navigate to the Audit Trails page
2. Locate the audit row with Processing_Result == Pending
3. Attempt to locate or click the Approve or Reject actions for that Pending row
test_cases.expected_result: Approve and Reject actions are not visible for the Pending row when maker-checker is disabled; attempting to perform approve/reject is blocked and the Processing_Result remains Pending

test_cases.test_case: Approve action unavailable for a record already Approved
preconditions: An audit trail row exists with Processing_Result == Approved
steps: 1. Navigate to the Audit Trails page
2. Locate the audit row with Processing_Result == Approved
3. Attempt to locate or click an Approve action for that Approved row
test_cases.expected_result: Approve action/button is not visible for records with Processing_Result == Approved; no approve action can be performed and the record remains in Approved state

test_cases.test_case: Reject action unavailable for a record already Rejected
preconditions: An audit trail row exists with Processing_Result == Rejected
steps: 1. Navigate to the Audit Trails page
2. Locate the audit row with Processing_Result == Rejected
3. Attempt to locate or click a Reject action for that Rejected row
test_cases.expected_result: Reject action/button is not visible for records with Processing_Result == Rejected; no reject action can be performed and the record remains in Rejected state

test_cases.test_case: Move_Up on the first code entry is blocked or disabled
preconditions: Open Manage Codes, click a code row to open Code_Detail where Values list is visible and the first entry is at the top of the list
steps: 1. In Code_Detail identify the first entry in the Values repeating group (top-most item)
2. Click the Move_Up action for that first entry
test_cases.expected_result: Move_Up control for the first entry is disabled or, if clicked, an inline message appears indicating it cannot be moved up further; the entry remains in the same position (order unchanged)

test_cases.test_case: Audit Trails — From_Date equal to To_Date (single-day range) is accepted
preconditions: User is authenticated and has access to the Audit Trails page
steps: 1. Navigate to the Audit Trails page
2. Set the To_Date filter to <date X>
3. Set the From_Date filter to <same date X>
4. Click the Apply_Filters action
test_cases.expected_result: Apply_Filters succeeds; audit trail table is filtered to records for <date X> only and an active filter indicator shows From_Date = <date X> and To_Date = <date X>

test_cases.test_case: Audit Trails — From_Date set after To_Date is blocked
preconditions: User is authenticated and has access to the Audit Trails page
steps: 1. Navigate to the Audit Trails page
2. Set the To_Date filter to <date X>
3. Set the From_Date filter to <one unit after date X>
4. Click the Apply_Filters action
test_cases.expected_result: Apply_Filters is blocked / error shown; an inline validation message is displayed on the From_Date field indicating the From_Date must be on or before the To_Date and the audit table is not filtered

test_cases.test_case: Code list — Attempt Move_Up on the first entry is blocked / no-op
preconditions: User is authenticated and has access to Manage Codes
A code list with at least one entry is displayed; the target entry is currently the first/topmost in the Code_Detail list
steps: 1. Open the Manage Codes page
2. Click the Open_Code action for the code list to open Code_Detail
3. Select the topmost entry in the Values repeating group
4. Click the Move_Up action for that entry
test_cases.expected_result: Move_Up is blocked / error shown; the order remains unchanged and a non-modal inline indicator adjacent to the entry indicates it cannot be moved higher (entry stays first)

test_cases.test_case: Code list — Attempt Move_Down on the last entry is blocked / no-op
preconditions: User is authenticated and has access to Manage Codes
A code list with at least one entry is displayed; the target entry is currently the last/bottommost in the Code_Detail list
steps: 1. Open the Manage Codes page
2. Click the Open_Code action for the code list to open Code_Detail
3. Select the bottommost entry in the Values repeating group
4. Click the Move_Down action for that entry
test_cases.expected_result: Move_Down is blocked / error shown; the order remains unchanged and a non-modal inline indicator adjacent to the entry indicates it cannot be moved lower (entry stays last)

test_cases.test_case: Code list — Deactivate all entries then Save (no-active-entries case)
preconditions: User is authenticated and has access to Manage Codes
A code list with at least one active entry is available
steps: 1. Open the Manage Codes page
2. Click the Open_Code action for the code list to open Code_Detail
3. For each entry in the Values repeating group, perform the Deactivate_Entry action (set Is_Active to unchecked)
4. Click the Save submit action in Code_Detail
test_cases.expected_result: Save succeeds; the code list is saved with all entries marked inactive and the Code_Detail page displays zero active entries (no entries shown as active)

test_cases.test_case: Manage Codes — Attempt to edit/add entries for a system-defined code list is blocked
preconditions: User is authenticated and has access to Manage Codes
A row in the Manage Codes table has Is_System_Defined = true
steps: 1. Open the Manage Codes page
2. Locate a code list row where Is_System_Defined is true
3. Click the Open_Code action for that row to open Code_Detail
4. Click the Add_Entry action and attempt to enter a new Entry_Value
5. Click the Save submit action in Code_Detail
test_cases.expected_result: Add_Entry or Save is blocked / error shown; the Add_Entry control is disabled or Save fails with an inline message indicating system-defined code lists cannot be edited and no new entry is added

test_cases.test_case: Code list Entry_Value with leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed on save
preconditions: User is authenticated and has access to Manage Codes
A code list is open in Code_Detail
steps: 1. Open the Manage Codes page
2. Click the Open_Code action for a code list to open Code_Detail
3. Click the Add_Entry action
4. Enter an Entry_Value with leading and trailing whitespace (e.g., '  <value>  ')
5. Click the Save submit action in Code_Detail
test_cases.expected_result: Save succeeds; the saved Entry_Value is displayed in the Code_Detail list with leading and trailing whitespace removed (trimmed) and the UI shows the trimmed value

test_cases.test_case: Open user profile menu shows 'Profile Settings' and 'Log Out' items
preconditions: User logged in as <User> and on an authenticated page where the User_Profile_Icon is visible
steps: 1. Click the User_Profile_Icon in the top-right corner
test_cases.expected_result: A dropdown menu is visible showing the items 'Profile Settings' and 'Log Out'

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to Profile Settings via profile menu
preconditions: User logged in as <User> and on an authenticated page where the User_Profile_Icon is visible
steps: 1. Click the User_Profile_Icon in the top-right corner to reveal the dropdown menu
2. Click the 'Profile Settings' item in the dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: The Profile Settings page is displayed (browser navigates to the Profile Settings page)

test_cases.test_case: Log out from profile menu redirects to Login page
preconditions: User logged in as <User> and on an authenticated page where the User_Profile_Icon is visible
steps: 1. Click the User_Profile_Icon in the top-right corner to reveal the dropdown menu
2. Click the 'Log Out' button in the dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: The Login page is displayed (user is redirected to the login page)

test_cases.test_case: After logout, attempting to open an authenticated page redirects to Login page
preconditions: User logged in as <User> and on an authenticated page where the User_Profile_Icon is visible
steps: 1. Click the User_Profile_Icon in the top-right corner to reveal the dropdown menu
2. Click the 'Log Out' button in the dropdown
3. Enter <authenticated page URL> in the browser address bar and press Enter
test_cases.expected_result: The Login page is displayed when navigating to <authenticated page>; the attempted authenticated page does not load and the user remains on the Login page

test_cases.test_case: Unauthenticated user cannot access profile menu or Log Out
preconditions: User is not authenticated (no active session)
steps: 1. Open the application home page in a new browser session with no authentication
2. Attempt to click the User_Profile_Icon in the top-right corner
3. Directly navigate the browser to <Log Out URL> (deep link to logout action)
test_cases.expected_result: User_Profile_Icon is not visible (precondition 'user must be logged in' enforced); Log Out menu item is not available. Direct navigation to <Log Out URL> redirects to the Login page and does not create an authenticated session. The page displays the Login screen (no authenticated content is shown).

test_cases.test_case: After logout, navigating to an authenticated page is blocked and redirects to login
preconditions: User has <valid credentials> and is initially logged in
steps: 1. Log in using <valid credentials>
2. Click the User_Profile_Icon in the top-right corner
3. Click the Log Out button in the dropdown
4. After redirect completes, attempt to navigate to <authenticated page URL>
test_cases.expected_result: Clicking 'Log Out' terminates the session and redirects to the Login page; authentication token is cleared (user no longer has access). Subsequent navigation to <authenticated page URL> redirects to the Login page and the authenticated page content is not displayed.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of Log Out (race on logout button)
preconditions: User is logged in
User_Profile_Icon is visible in the top-right
steps: 1. Click User_Profile_Icon
2. Click the "Log Out" button (first click)
3. Immediately click the "Log Out" button again (second click) before the redirect completes
test_cases.expected_result: First click terminates the authenticated session, clears the authentication token, and redirects to the login page — logout succeeds. The second click is ignored (no additional error shown); user remains on the login page and the User_Profile_Icon is no longer visible.

test_cases.test_case: Browser Back after logout does not reveal authenticated content
preconditions: User is logged in
User_Profile_Icon is visible in the top-right
steps: 1. Click User_Profile_Icon
2. Click the "Log Out" button
3. On the redirected login page, press the browser Back button once
test_cases.expected_result: Back navigation to an authenticated page is blocked: the application redirects to and remains on the login page (no authenticated content is shown) — access is blocked. The logout from step 2 succeeded and authentication token is cleared; User_Profile_Icon is not visible.

test_cases.test_case: Log out in Tab A then attempt authenticated action in Tab B
preconditions: User is logged in in two separate browser tabs (Tab A and Tab B)
Both tabs show authenticated UI with User_Profile_Icon visible
steps: 1. Switch to Tab A
2. Click User_Profile_Icon in Tab A
3. Click the "Log Out" button in Tab A
4. Switch to Tab B
5. In Tab B, click a link to an authenticated page or click User_Profile_Icon
test_cases.expected_result: The logout performed in Tab A succeeds (session terminated, token cleared, Tab A redirected to login page). The attempt in Tab B to access authenticated functionality is blocked: Tab B is redirected to the login page and no authenticated content is shown; User_Profile_Icon is not accessible in Tab B.

test_cases.test_case: Click Log Out after session has expired but profile icon still visible
preconditions: User is logged in and User_Profile_Icon is visible
Allow the session to expire (wait until session timeout)
steps: 1. Wait until the session timeout occurs (session becomes expired)
2. Click User_Profile_Icon
3. Click the "Log Out" button
test_cases.expected_result: Clicking Log Out after session expiry gracefully redirects to the login page and clears any remaining authentication state; logout succeeds with no error shown. The login page is displayed and User_Profile_Icon is not visible; subsequent attempts to access authenticated pages redirect to the login page (access is blocked).
